query: UPDATE background_jobs SET state = 'failed', failure_reason = $3, finished_at = statement_timestamp(), claim_expires_at = NULL, error_summary = $4, errors = (CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(errors) >= $5 THEN errors - 0 ELSE errors END) || jsonb_build_object('attempt', attempts, 'at', statement_timestamp(), 'error', $4::text) WHERE id = $1 AND claim_generation = $2 AND claim_token = $6 AND claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL
